GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.

2. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Haus
   C. Wasser
   D. Schule

3. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.

2. D — Schule

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

6. B — Good day / hello

7. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

10. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
